trigger_tokens.description: Absolute watermark in Provider input tokens, capped by the ratio; null: ratio-only, the watermark is trigger_ratio of the hard input limit.

trigger_ratio.description: The watermark as a share of the hard input limit.

target_ratio.description: Telemetry: the next request's Provider input should stay under this share of the hard limit.

checkpoint_target_tokens.description: The checkpoint length asked of the compactor (estimated tokens).

checkpoint_max_tokens.description: The checkpoint's soft maximum (estimated tokens), telemetry.

enabled.description: false only when a context pack turns rollout compaction off.

unit.description: What the checkpoint absorbs; absent: action_step. exchange: every exchange before the exact tail, which then counts in exchanges too (segments.exact_tail_unit exchange).
